steps.en: Install the pack once into the shared skills directory
steps.zh: 一条命令把整套装进共享 skills 目录
steps.code: npx skills add tw93/Waza -a claude-code codex cursor -g -y

steps.en: One copy lands in ~/.agents/skills and links into every agent that reads it
steps.zh: 一份拷贝落在 ~/.agents/skills，链进每个读它的 agent

steps.en: Call the habit that matches the moment: plan, debug, or review
steps.zh: 在对应时刻调用对应的习惯动词

steps.en: The skill runs its playbook: outcome, red lines, verification, from its docs and gotchas
steps.zh: skill 按手册执行：定结果、划红线、给验证，附文档与坑

steps.en: Approve the plan, let the agent implement, then gate the merge
steps.zh: 批准计划后开工，合并前再过评审

steps.en: The review checks the diff against the repo's own context and acts only where you authorized
steps.zh: 评审对照仓库自身上下文审 diff，只做你授权的动作

value.en: Planning, root-cause debugging, and diff review run in every session without maintaining your own skill stack
value.zh: 规划、根因调试、diff 评审每个会话都在跑，而你不用自己维护一套 skill 栈

README.md Skills table (/think, /ui, /check, /hunt, /write, /learn, /read, /health) and 'Each skill is a folder with reference docs, helper scripts, and gotchas from real failures'

README.md /check row: 'Reviews the diff against project constraints, verifies the result, and handles approved release and maintainer actions'; Project Context section (READMEs, package manifests, Makefiles, CI workflows)
README.md Why section: 'Each Waza skill states the outcome, the red lines, and how the result gets verified, then steps back and lets the model choose the path'
